refused: firewall: ufw is installed but not active, and admit will not enable it: it found no port sshd listens on, and it never enables ufw without allowing the port your own login arrives by. Enabling ufw without an allow for your SSH port cuts off SSH to this host: allow the port your SSH server listens on with `sudo ufw allow <port>/tcp` before anything enables ufw, then run admit again. Nothing was changed
